findings.excerpt: The round turned through holes 8 to 11, where he gathered 14 points.
Henry Meller took a quintuple bogey at the 3rd and sank to the bottom of the TEG 8 Wooden Spoon table after three holes.
Stuart Neumann's triple bogey at the 4th relieved him of it, and Neumann then set about defending his claim with real commitment.
Between the 7th and the 15th he bled 29 shots.
